Title: New card idea: Pawn of Hunedoara

Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
Pawn of Hunedoara
Requires a non-anarch, non-Black Hand vampire of capacity 8 or more.
+2 stealth action
Put this card on this vampire. Once per turn, this vampire may burn 1 blood to untap. Burn this card if this vampire votes in a referendum och plays a card that requires a title.

Game development:
Big caps without title or fortitude seldom see play.

Flavor:
The Inconnu (or one part of it?) highly secretive sect based in Hunedoara, Transylvania. They are after Golconda, or are they infernalists? They recruit old vampires that are not very affiliated with the Jyhad. Being part of their network has advantages.

Balance:
- Narrow in appliance, tries to pin-point seldom used vampires. The reason for not making it “non-titled” is the huge amount of high-cap primogen and bishops that never see play.
- Strong effect, but doesn´t make bleed+vote possible (ie too much ousting power) – might open for some tricky decks though.

Competitiveness:
Not sure. What do you think?

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."

Messages.Author: direwolf
Messages.Body:
> Ohlmann wrote:
>
> > Ashur wrote:
> > Non-infernal: Yes, although I would prefer not too add that, because of the rumours of the Inconnu being infernalists.
> >
> But they are not open infernalists. Infernals vampire in VtES are vampire which are evidently infernal. If the inconnu were dealing openly with Petaniqua, they would quickly be known as infernalists, not just rumored to be.
>
> If you want, infernal are the demon army, while non-infernal pawns are corrupters.

First of all, there is no "openly infernal" or "closet infernal." An infernal vampire is infernal, exhorting a cost to the Methuselah controlling them. (In the case of non advanced vampires, the non advanced versions are in fact, not infernal.)

Whether a vampire is "known" to be infernal or not does not matter. Just because a vampire in V:tES has the text "Infernal" does not mean that the rest of the vampires in the game "knows" that the vampire is infernal (in fact, that is irrelevant.)

Also, I take issue with "inconnu dealing openly with Petanique." The Inconnu is a "secret society" if at all they actually exist. They don't deal openly. And if they are rumored to deal with Patanique.... As I mentioned above, it is not necessarily well known that Patanique is infernal (though she is Red List, so in this case, maybe it is well known?)

Independent Futurist. Contrarian (titled, X votes where X is the number of votes as the acting minion.) Target Vitals is always the better combat card.

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
For starters it needs to be one per minion. Maybe even unique.

And even then, all it does is help the guys with fortitude more. I don't think adding an action-based *disciplineless* permanent untap is a good idea. Especially one that costs no actual action since you get to use it right away.

And if you do, you have to look at its relative power with the existing ones. Helicopter, for example, is as close as it gets and that costs 3 pool, is an equipment, cannot be used the round you get it AND only works on successfull actions.

Rutor's Hand requires a fairly uncommon discipline, cannot be used the turn you get it and sends you to torpor.

I suppose there's Tattoo Signal which is actually amazingly insanely strong, but that requires a Seraph of which there are a whole 9. Ye ye, there is this vote card, but really, did anyone actually put that card in a serious deck, like ever? It also untaps another vampire and not the one with the card.

The non-Anarch non-Black Hand restriction seems completely random. Is that to prevent abuse with CrimethInc or Tattoo Signal? And if so why can it be abused with fortitude untap, which is the more realistic scenario?

And what about stacking it with Enkil Cog? Metro Underground and Enkil Cog is already pretty abusive as is, but at least it costs a pool and Metro Underground is a master.

And what about Infernals? This card basically removes the infernal penalty. And aside from that, Cybele is already quite competitive enough when she has 1 action per turn.

Totally broken. I´d much see fortitude untap powered down instead of power creeping everything else up to that level.

Messages.Author: direwolf
Messages.Body:
> Ohlmann wrote:
>
> > direwolf wrote:
> > Whether a vampire is "known" to be infernal or not does not matter. Just because a vampire in V:tES has the text "Infernal" does not mean that the rest of the vampires in the game "knows" that the vampire is infernal (in fact, that is irrelevant.)
> >
> By this reasoning, the base version of Marcus Vitel should be Lasombra, not Ventrue.
>
Not so. Clan is a perceived factor, I.E. "Clan Impersonation." A vampire can masquerade as a member of another clan in order to use the benefits (and restrictions!) of that clan.

An infernal vampire exhorts it's cost from the Methuselah regardless of whether you use cards that would indicate that the vampire is infernal. You can have a deck with infernal vampires, without a single card that requires an infernal vampire.

Independent Futurist. Contrarian (titled, X votes where X is the number of votes as the acting minion.) Target Vitals is always the better combat card.

Messages.Author: jAvel
Messages.Body:
Pawn of Hunedoara
Cost: 2 pool.
Requires a vampire of capacity 8 or more.
+2 stealth action
Put this card on this vampire. Once per your minion phase, this vampire may untap. This vampire burns additional blood when untapping during your minion phase. Burn this card if this vampire votes in a referendum, plays a card that requires a title or becomes infernal.

* prevents using it with other untap cards.
* costs 1 blood to untap.
* costs pool to represent difficulty of contactin Iconnu
* infernal thing is optional.
